entries.mem0ai/mem0: A universal memory layer providing multi-level state management for users, sessions, and agents. It utilizes hybrid retrieval combining semantic, keyword, and entity matching with time-awareness to track current and past events.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: A high-performance memory engine featuring a custom vector graph engine and byte-level deduplication for prompt-cache efficiency. It manages persistent user profiles and handles temporal changes, contradictions, and automatic forgetting via native connectors for Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An open-source context database that uses a tiered L0/L1/L2 loading system to reduce token costs and improve task completion. It organizes memories and skills via a filesystem-based structure and provides visualized retrieval trajectories for debugging.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated agent brain that synthesizes cited answers and performs explicit gap analysis on missing information. It features a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges that requires zero LLM calls and supports scoped institutional memory for teams.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A learning-focused memory system that implements retain, recall, and reflect workflows for long-term knowledge retention. It integrates as an LLM wrapper supporting providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Ollama with minimal code.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A reasoning-first memory library that extracts conclusions from events and conversations to build stateful agents. It employs peer-centric modeling for users and groups and combines BM25 with vector search for hybrid retrieval.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: A memory provider that treats context as a git repository, utilizing a markdown context tree with commit, branch, and merge versioning. It offers a 5-tier retrieval system for sub-100ms latency and integrates with over 20 LLM providers.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that generates persistent playbooks and artifacts to help agents solve complex tasks. It supports local Pi runtimes and major LLM APIs with MCP and CLI integration for coding agents.
entries.AxDSan/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system using SQLite to achieve sub-millisecond retrieval latency. It features a temporal knowledge graph and episodic compression for efficient storage, with native MCP support for Cursor and Claude Code.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a hierarchical summary DAG for depth-aware compaction. It includes dedicated tools for grep and source-aware retrieval, backed by SQLite with sensitive pattern redaction.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend for the Honcho library that enables private cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent. It supports any OpenAI-compatible provider or local inference server and includes a Docker-based setup script.
entries.plur-ai/plur: A shared memory layer for multi-agent systems using an open engram YAML format for local-first storage. It implements an ACT-R based activation model for automatic memory decay and hierarchical scoping for team-level knowledge.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: A local-first identity and secrets layer that provides portable state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and MCP clients. It uses SQLite for custody and provides tools to manually edit, delete, or reclassify context.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device context engine that eliminates cloud dependencies and API keys for total local privacy. It combines BM25, vector search, and knowledge graphs, integrating via MCP servers and Claude Code hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: A context optimization tool that increases prefill speed by 1.5–3× through prefix cache reuse. It reduces prompt token usage by approximately 36% and provides native plugin support for Hermes Agent and OpenClaw.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: A self-maintaining, in-process memory plugin that provides explainable recall via 'why_retrieved' tags. It tracks contradictions and canonicalizes duplicates without requiring a separate server or GPU.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: A memory kernel stack that consolidates temporal continuity, graph truth, and corpus retrieval. It leverages a multi-layered storage approach using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide bounded evidence packing.
entries.keepnotes-ai/keep: A reflective memory system that combines BM25 full-text search with ranked graph traversal. It automatically indexes local directories and URLs, using edge tags to create navigable relationships with inverse links.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses a local-first SQLite-vec and GGUF model architecture via node-llama-cpp as an MCP-native server.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: A utility that reduces tool-schema prompt overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select only relevant tools. It includes a dashboard to track token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin using a columnar .lbdb embedded graph database with importance-weighted recall. It surfaces high-priority memories first and supports optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that ensures true deletion of memories to prevent persistent summaries from haunting future recall. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log for every memory operation.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: A plugin that integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory. It offers tools for manual storage and searching, along with configurable query expansion and result reranking.

entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system for macOS and Windows that integrates with coding agents via an MCP server. It provides Hermes Agent access to over 100 skills, 150 design systems, and 261 plugins.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: A library of 754 structured cybersecurity skills mapped to major frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. It follows the agentskills.io standard for discovery across 26+ AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: Enables the generation of draw.io diagrams from natural language, supporting presets like ERD, UML, and Flowcharts. It can visualize codebase structures for Python, JS-TS, Go, and Rust using thousands of official shapes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: An agentic evolver that automates skill deduplication and quality improvement through background evolution loops. It unifies skill libraries across teams and devices with native support for Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: An auditing tool that eliminates detectable AI writing patterns through rewrite, detect, and edit-in-place modes. It utilizes a two-pass detection system and 49 pattern categories to ensure human-like content.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform skills library based on industry guidelines and established books. It offers modular installation via npx or a plugin marketplace for Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically propose and generate reusable skills. It produces both Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation via dedicated slash commands.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI using progressive disclosure to reduce token usage. It supports both programmatic and filesystem-based Python skill definitions.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: A set of tools for extracting transcripts, captions, and timestamps from YouTube without using yt-dlp. It enables video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for Hermes Agent and other compatible agents.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A community hub for browsing and one-click installation of skills, featuring automated security scanning with 65+ threat detection rules. It includes a creator marketplace with crypto and Stripe payment protocols.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: Teaches Hermes Agent to generate its own analytical prompts using dynamic custom lenses via /prism-scan. It includes seven validated prisms for simulation and optimization, with /prism-reflect to identify analysis blind spots.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: A set of workflow skills that transform rough ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs. It offers Lite and Full modes and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: A local-first Rust binary that manages long-running agents through structured memory and a plan-approve-execute cycle. It uses a durable card model for tracking tasks and evidence-backed QA gates for verification.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: A literate programming skill that weaves prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable code and automatically syncs edits back to the documentation.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: A memory system that captures high-value decisions via markdown files for cross-instance sharing. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on captured work.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Provides agentskills.io-compliant tools for interacting with the Chainlink oracle network, including CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. These skills are installable via the Vercel skills CLI.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: Converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It ensures provenance through pinned commits and file:line citations while providing lifecycle tooling for versioning.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: The official FLUX image generation skills providing standardized prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2. It includes API integration patterns for webhooks and support for precise hex color specifications.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: A registry of reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification featuring a Python client and CLI. It supports versioned installation with recursive dependency resolution and Stripe/TON payment rails.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Facilitates the autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time progress tracking. It includes built-in rollback procedures to ensure safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that uses three-layer lazy loading to minimize token consumption. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and supports hot-reloading of configurations.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: Integrates Hermes Agent with Nextcloud to manage files, notes, calendars, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It uses HTTPS and App Passwords for secure communication.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C# / .NET implementation of the agentskills.io specification with MCP integration. It leverages Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based loading and implements progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: A plugin that rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces like Discord and Telegram based on model reasoning capabilities. It tracks token savings and quality scores in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: An adversarial code review tool that uses three parallel subagents to hunt for bugs and exploitability. It integrates Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec for deterministic pre-scanning and uses an MCP server for false-positive suppression.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: A multi-agent swarm that simplifies code by targeting hygiene, clarity, and correctness. It uses a risk-tiered triage system to safely modify code and detect language-specific anti-patterns.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: An intelligent retrieval system for Hermes Agent that uses a five-layer approach, including FTS5 and dense embeddings. It filters large skill libraries down to the five most relevant options to reduce token usage.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: Automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC via protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is compatible with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: A collection of Nix packages that enables instant execution of Hermes and other AI coding agents via nix run commands. It ensures tools stay current through daily automatic updates.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: Provides scripts and configuration guides for running agent CLIs, including Hermes, on Android smartphones. It leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI to grant the agent access to mobile hardware and UI.
entries.rookiemann/portable-hermes-agent: A zero-install Windows desktop distribution featuring a GUI and 100 built-in tools. It supports local models via LM Studio and includes a dynamic tool maker for custom automation pipelines.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: A Termux-based deployment guide featuring a one-line installation script for rapid Android setup. It supports persistent memory and compatibility with over 200 AI models, including local Ollama instances.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: A community Helm chart for Kubernetes deployments that implements cloud-native state-safety guardrails. It enforces single-writer safety for persistent storage and supports both direct deployment and CRD-based workflows.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: A security-focused deployment that sandboxes the agent with hardware-enforced kernel-level blocking of dangerous syscalls and network egress. It offers dynamic security policies ranging from strict to permissive access.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: A streamlined Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for custom tag builds.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: A NixOS module and package for declarative, reproducible deployments. It integrates sops-nix for secure secrets handling and manages agent configurations as systemd services.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: A production-ready headless deployment that configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service on Ubuntu and Debian. It is designed for autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: A Docker-first control plane that allows users to operate multiple Hermes Agent instances from a single web application. It provides hierarchy-aware task scheduling and inter-agent delegation across separate workspaces.
entries.ellickjohnson/portainer-stack-hermes: A Docker Compose stack designed for Portainer deployment that includes a ttyd web terminal for remote access. It utilizes GitHub Actions for automated image builds.

entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: A self-hosted orchestration stack that uses a zero-dependency SQLite backend to dispatch tasks and monitor spend. It provides multi-gateway support for frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph, featuring an Aegis review system for quality control.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project offers a TUI and PWA dashboard to monitor diverse coding agents, including Hermes and Claude Code, within isolated sandboxes. It enables parallel execution by leveraging git worktrees and multi-repo workspaces.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: A tiered architecture template designed to scale from a single VPS agent to full specialist teams. It utilizes a task bus pattern for delegation and includes bundled skills for security auditing and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This control-room template uses a level-based architecture to transition from individual agents to automated, orchestrated workflows. It features a task bus for specialist handoffs and includes skills for VPS provisioning and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: An orchestration platform for building autonomous swarms that supports over 23 LLM providers, including Ollama and OpenRouter. It provides visual org charts, durable agent memory, and support for scheduled runs.
entries.Agent-3-7/minions: A centralized mission control interface that uses a Kanban board to track autonomous task statuses and review queues. It allows users to live-stream agent reasoning and perform human-in-the-loop verification on all completed tasks.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: A local collaboration system that orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents through a real-time Web UI. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols to manage tool handling and agent dialogue flows via a Kanban interface.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: A specialized pipeline for end-to-end software development featuring 17 distinct agents for roles like research, implementation, and infrastructure. The system enforces mandatory quality gates through dedicated reviewer and tester agents.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: A meta-optimization tool that uses automated outer-loop search to refine Hermes Agent harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TB2 benchmark evaluations to track performance frontiers through structured candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: An agent-vs-agent arena where autonomous AI companies compete for GitHub stars. The platform orchestrates nine agents, including Hermes, and provides a real-time dashboard to visualize tasks and scoreboard metrics.
entries.Rainhoole/hermes-agent-acp-skill: A delegation tool that routes tasks between Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code using ACP-style workflows. It prevents parent context pollution through isolation and enforces safety via configurable timeouts and character limits.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: A local pre-indexed code knowledge graph that optimizes agent performance by providing symbol relationships and call graphs. It reduces token consumption and tool calls through an auto-syncing index that updates on every file change.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A Rust-powered CLI tool designed to monitor token usage and costs across 20+ AI coding agents. It features a native TUI for local tracking and generates 3D contribution graphs and public leaderboards.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: A local trace viewer for inspecting API traffic, allowing developers to analyze system prompts, tool schemas, and streaming responses. It provides structured diffs for comparing requests and exports sessions to portable HTML files.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that acts as an autonomous CTO loop for issue triage and PR management. It equips Hermes Agent with 23 specialized skills and integrations for Vercel, Supabase, and GitHub.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: A collection of community-driven CLI themes and skins to customize the Hermes terminal UI. It offers everything from retro DOS to cyberpunk aesthetics via customizable colors, ASCII banners, and spinner verbs.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: A port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. This version runs natively without OAuth or external processes and includes MLOps tools for RL training and vLLM inference.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser that enables autonomous agent control via MCP. It provides a human-visible UI for real-time supervision, featuring durable state, action undo, and agent-specific bookmarks.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: A TAW Agent framework that enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents with per-folder configurations. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents with project-local memories and tools.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: A preconfigured setup utilizing RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings. It includes 40+ specialized skills for research, finance, and devops with automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: A rapid deployment stack that launches Hermes Agent using Docker, LiteLLM, Ollama, and Qdrant. It provides a zero-cost environment featuring 29 community plugins and automated routing for free models.
entries.roli-lpci/lintlang: A deterministic static linter that scans agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts without using LLM calls. It utilizes seven structural detectors to identify failure modes and integrates directly into CI/CD pipelines.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: A migration utility that transfers personas, memories, and skills from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent. It maps complex model configurations to Hermes YAML format and handles the transfer of system-level credentials.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A high-performance, cross-platform manager built with Tauri 2 for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides a unified control center for managing Hermes Agent alongside other CLIs like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local open-source coworking application that offers a unified interface for various agent CLIs. It features a built-in agent with MCP tool support and the ability to automatically generate editable office documents like .pptx and .xlsx.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A zero-build web interface designed for full feature parity with the Hermes Agent CLI experience. It utilizes a three-panel layout to provide workspace file browsing and inline previews directly from your browser or phone.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A dedicated desktop companion app that simplifies the installation and configuration process for Hermes Agent. It includes integrated management for local and remote AI providers, memory, tools, and scheduled tasks.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui: A comprehensive web dashboard that enables multi-platform AI chat and session management via SQLite. It allows for unified configuration across various channels including Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring a robust Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers. The interface integrates a Monaco-powered file browser, an MCP catalog, and a PTY terminal.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native macOS workspace designed for direct interaction with Hermes hosts via local or SSH connections. It provides specialized views for Kanban boards, skills, cron jobs, and an embedded terminal for system repair.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard that features the ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and Kanban pipelines. It offers a full MCP server control plane, real-time streaming chat, and system metrics.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS cockpit focused on session browsing and analytics for Hermes and other coding-agent CLIs. It provides unified search and live session monitoring through a local-only indexing system with no telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS workspace optimized for interacting with Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features one-click automated installation and integrated WebRTC voice mode using OpenAI Realtime.
entries.Eynzof/hermes-agent-cn-desktop: A Windows-first desktop application built with Tauri that also supports macOS. It includes built-in kernel management for updates and health checks, alongside support for LaTeX and Mermaid rendering.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative TUI and dashboard built using OpenTUI for a terminal-centric experience. It features integrated chat with markdown rendering and Kanban boards for diagnosing and dispatching agentic work.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed as a Telegram Mini App for managing Hermes on the go. It supports terminal chat with file attachments, background agent spawning, and system health monitoring.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A zero-install, portable Windows desktop GUI that requires no admin rights or Docker. It includes over 100 tools, including ComfyUI and MusicGen integrations, and features a dynamic tool maker for custom API wrappers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A sleek, glassmorphic single-file React web interface for self-hosted assistance. It integrates a file browser, terminal, and real-time log streaming for managing MCP servers and cron jobs.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A lightweight process monitoring and configuration dashboard. It provides a real-time activity feed via WebSockets and FTS5 search for inspecting session histories and environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first self-hosted workspace that includes an integrated marketplace for discovering skills and MCP servers. It features real-time SSE streaming, tool approval cards, and isolated profile management.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A multi-agent desktop client designed to orchestrate collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It includes a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and a native streaming chat interface.
